meta.status_detail: Mechanically migrated 2026-09-18 from the JOURNAL_STYLE_PRESETS dict literal in docs_intel.py (round 2, proposal 64266f13, dated 2026-09-11) as part of the JSON-preset externalization work (proposal 3b93b7ef) -- values and evidence carried over verbatim from the real in-code comment, not regenerated. CAVEAT (inherited from proposal 64266f13, not independently re-verified in this pass): round-2 noted an unspecified sub-journal inconsistency for AIP, the way ACM's round-1 preset flagged one for its own sub-formats. This pass's search reached AIP's general author-instructions and style-manual pages (not each individual AIP sub-journal's own guide -- e.g. Journal of Applied Physics vs. Applied Physics Letters each maintain separate pages), so the specific sub-journal inconsistency the proposal had in mind was not independently confirmed or refuted here. Marked partially_populated rather than silently upgraded to an unqualified tier 2, per this caveat.
